description: Test suite for TalkConfigParsing functionalities in the OpenClawKit project, focusing on provider configuration selection, fallback mechanisms, and data bridging.

methods.name: prefersCanonicalResolvedTalkProviderPayload
methods.description: Tests whether the parser correctly identifies and prioritizes the canonical resolved provider payload.

methods.name: rejectsNormalizedTalkProviderPayloadWithoutResolved
methods.description: Verifies that payloads lacking a resolved section are rejected.

methods.name: fallsBackToLegacyTalkFieldsWhenNormalizedPayloadMissing
methods.description: Ensures fallback to legacy fields occurs when normalized payload is absent.

methods.name: canDisableLegacyFallback
methods.description: Validates that disabling fallback prevents selection when only legacy fields are present.

methods.name: rejectsNormalizedPayloadWhenProviderMissingFromProviders
methods.description: Checks that normalized payloads are rejected if the provider isn't listed.

methods.name: rejectsNormalizedPayloadWhenMultipleProvidersAndNoProvider
methods.description: Ensures rejection when multiple providers are defined but no default provider is specified.

methods.name: bridgesFoundationDictionary
methods.description: Tests the conversion bridging foundation dictionary to expected internal representation.

methods.name: resolvesPositiveIntegerTimeout
methods.description: Tests the resolution of positive integer timeout values with fallbacks.
